name: Baggage Claim
summary: An airport 404 page: pages ride a baggage carousel, and your missing page is the last bag down the chute
about: A full not-found page set in an arrivals hall. Suitcases tagged with the site's pages go round a moving carousel under a flickering Belt 404 sign, while a plane taxis past the window. Visitors track a bag by its tag or grab one off the belt, and when the trolley is full the alarm spins and the missing page finally slides down the chute.
how: The sign flickers on and the bags drop onto the belt, then a short demo tracks and claims a few bags by itself
Type a page name in Track a bag, or press a Try chip; the belt speeds up to bring that bag round to you
Click any bag going round to claim it; it flies onto your trolley and its luggage tag links to that page
Claim three bags, or press Report it missing, and the beacon spins as your page's bag slides down the chute
Open that last bag for a burst of paper tags and a way home; Start over puts every bag back on the belt
Below the hall, the lost property desk lists popular pages and files a missing page report with a reference
